messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release v1.12.3 -> prod by @maya. Running pre/postdeploy checks. release_id=rls_2027_03_18_01 :rocket:

deploy-bot: Postdeploy check `config-check` FAILED on prod. Summary: prod configmap missing key `FEATURE_X_ENABLED`; secret `db-credentials` KMS tag mismatch vs staging. See /release/rls_2027_03_18_01/logs :rotating_light:

maya: seeing the same locally. stg has FEATURE_X_ENABLED=true in `app-config`; prod has no key.

ravi: that flag was added in the canary patch yesterday. Config sync job didn't pick up the new k/v? :thinking_face:

maya: `kubectl -n prod get configmap app-config -o yaml`
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: app-config
data:
  LOG_LEVEL: "info"
  MAX_WORKERS: "8"
  # FEATURE_X_ENABLED missing
```

carla: if prod doesn't have the flag, behavior will fallback to old code path. We should avoid leaving partial shims. Options: quick config patch, or rollback to previous image.

ben: what about the secret mismatch? deploy logs show KMS key `projects/redwood/keys/prod` vs `projects/redwood/keys/staging` tag on the secret. Could be rotation timing.

k8s-bot: @ben noted secret `db-credentials` version v12 in prod, v13 in staging. No automatic fallback present.

ravi: quick patch to add FEATURE_X_ENABLED=true in prod will get customers back to expected behavior, but we'll still have secret version divergence. Any rollout with mismatched secret may cause DB connection hiccups.

maya: Recommend rollback to previous image (pin to last stable sha) to restore full parity until we fix config management. I'm +1 rollback to keep SLOs.

ben: opening rollback PR + pinning image now. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/deployments/pull/4822 — pin image to `ghcr.io/redwood/app@sha256:7f4a9b2` and revert release metadata.

deploy-bot: Rollback triggered by @ben. Starting rollout to 50%.

carla: I'll watch error budget, prepare rollback notes for oncall. maya, can you take a follow-up to sync config repo?

maya: on it. I'll create issue in infra-config repo to add automated detection for new keys and require a staged approval before release. tagging @ravi.

ben: Rollout to 100% complete. deploy-bot: Rollback successful, release v1.12.3 reverted. Metrics look stable. :white_check_mark:

k8s-bot: note: post-action check shows `app-config` parity still broken (staging has the new key). We should avoid one-off prod edits.

maya: Agreed. Creating infra-config issue and a small follow-up PR to add the missing key to config repo (will not apply to prod until we have rotation and KMS alignment).

ravi: filing a post-incident ticket: INC-2027-0318-config-parity. We'll add steps: 1) reconcile secrets/KMS, 2) add detection in deploy pipeline, 3) update release playbook.

carla: thanks all. We'll delay the next deploy window by 24h until config sync validated.

maya: will update release notes and send a short runbook blurb to #all-hands about the rollback and next steps. :memo:
